P14k: “Nothing suppressed, everything processed” can be taken to mean that someone in the group must tell all, even if they don’t want to. I have seen that risk in groups that use the ZEGG Forum practice. The group starts out just inviting people to be honest, and then at some point, keeping something private gets treated as resistance.
